summary:

Internship Type: Undergraduate, Pre-University
Network and protocol research is important to improve the overall cybersecurity posture. An understanding of the network communications and the protocols within can reveal vulnerabilities that could be exploited by attackers. In this fast-changing landscape, researchers need to actively analyze updated or new protocols to stay ahead of any possible threats. To support the research, the analysis tools used by the researchers need to continuously evolve to adapt to the changing research requirements.
You can work on multiple aspects within network and protocol analysis work to gain a good understanding of the research and contribute to building secure remote communications.
